paragraphs: Sec. 62.051. MINIMUM WAGE. Except as provided by Section 62.057, an employer shall pay to each employee <ins>not less than the greater of:</ins>
<ins>(1) $15 an hour; or</ins>
<ins>(2)</ins> the federal minimum wage under Section 6, Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 (29 U.S.C. Section 206).
